lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisai sarevahu praaneeho jis dai naau palai ||
lines.translation: Serve Him, O mortals, who has the Lord's Name in His lap.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਰਹਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai rahahu suheliaa agai naal chalai ||
lines.translation: You shall dwell in peace and ease in this world; in the world hereafter, it shall go with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਸਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਗਡਿ ਥੰਮੁ ਅਹਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ba(n)dhahu sach dharam kaa gad tha(n)m ahalai ||
lines.translation: So build your home of true righteousness, with the unshakable pillars of Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਝਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot laihu naaraainai deen duneeaa jhalai ||
lines.translation: Take the Support of the Lord, who gives support in the spiritual and material worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਲੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pakaRe charan har tis daragah malai ||8||
lines.translation: Nanak grasps the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he humbly bows in His Court. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਚਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaachak ma(n)gai daan dehi piaariaa ||
lines.translation: The beggar begs for charity: give to me, O my Beloved!

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: devanahaar daataar mai nit chitaariaa ||
lines.translation: O Great Giver, O Giving Lord, my consciousness is continually centered on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੂਲਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nikhut na jaaee mool atul bha(n)daariaa ||
lines.translation: The immeasurable warehouses of the Lord can never be emptied out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad apaar tin sabh kichh saariaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Word of the Shabad is infinite; it has arranged everything perfectly. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: sikhahu sabad piaariho janam maran kee tek ||
lines.translation: O Sikhs, love the Word of the Shabad; in life and death, it is our only support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukh oojal sadaa sukhee naanak simarat ek ||2||
lines.translation: Your face shall be radiant, and you shall find a lasting peace, O Nanak, remembering the One Lord in meditation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai a(n)mrit va(n)deeai sukheeaa har karane ||
lines.translation: There, the Ambrosial Nectar is distributed; the Lord is the Bringer of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam kai pa(n)th na paaeeahi phir naahee marane ||
lines.translation: They are not placed upon the path of Death, and they shall not have to die again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no aaiaa prem ras tisai hee jarane ||
lines.translation: One who comes to savor the Lord's Love experiences it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਅਮਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਝਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee ucharahi saadh jan amiu chalahi jharane ||
lines.translation: The Holy beings chant the Bani of the Word, like nectar flowing from a spring.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: pekh darasan naanak jeeviaa man a(n)dar dharane ||9||
lines.translation: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those who have implanted the Lord's Name within their minds. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਖਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur poorai seviai dookhaa kaa hoi naas ||
lines.translation: Serving the Perfect True Guru, suffering ends.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araadhiai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam in adoration, one's affairs come to be resolved. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat sa(n)kat chhutahi anad ma(n)gal bisraam ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, misfortune departs, and one comes to abide in peace and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak japeeai sadaa har nimakh na bisarau naam ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord - do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee jinee har har ladhaa ||
lines.translation: How can I estimate the glory of those, who have found the Lord, Har, Har?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਾ ਸਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਛੁਟੈ ਬਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhaa saranee jo pavai so chhutai badhaa ||
lines.translation: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is released from bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀਐ ਜੋਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਦਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai abinaaseeai jon garabh na dadhaa ||
lines.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord does not burn in the womb of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bhetiaa paarabraham har paR bujh samadhaa ||
lines.translation: One who meets the Guru and the Supreme Lord God, who reads and understands, enters the state of Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਧਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paaiaa so dhanee har agam agadhaa ||10||
lines.translation: Nanak has obtained that Lord Master, who is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam na karahee aapanaa phirahi avataa loi ||
lines.translation: People do not perform their duties, but instead, they wander around aimlessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naai visaariai sukh kinehaa hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if they forget the Name, how can they ever find peace? ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਕਉੜਤਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai kauRatan sagal maahi jagat rahee lapataai ||
lines.translation: The bitter poison of corruption is everywhere; it clings to the substance of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jan veechaariaa meethaa har kaa naau ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the humble being has realized that the Name of the Lord alone is sweet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih neesaanee saadh kee jis bhetat tareeai ||
lines.translation: This is the distinguishing sign of the Holy Saint, that by meeting with him, one is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamaka(n)kar neR na aavaee phir bahuR na mareeai ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not come near him; he never has to die again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhav saagar sa(n)saar bikh so paar utareeai ||
lines.translation: He crosses over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁੰਫਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gu(n)phahu man maal har sabh mal parahareeai ||
lines.translation: So weave the garland of the Lord's Glorious Praises into your mind, and all your filth shall be washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak preetam mil rahe paarabraham narahareeai ||11||
lines.translation: Nanak remains blended with his Beloved, the Supreme Lord God. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan hai jin har vuthaa chit ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, approved is the birth of those, within whose consciousness the Lord abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਅਲ ਪਲਾਲੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਿਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gaalhee al palaaleeaa ka(n)m na aavahi mit ||1||
lines.translation: Useless talk and babbling is useless, my friend. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਗਮ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham prabh drisatee aaiaa pooran agam bisamaad ||
lines.translation: I have come to see the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Inaccessible, Wonderful Lord.
